LEGLOCK

Privacy Policy

Effective November 6, 2026

Overview

LEGLOCK is a sports statistics research tool. This policy explains what data this page uses, what stays on your own device, and what third parties may collect when you visit.

Effective November 6, 2026

Data the page uses

Game and player statistics shown in LEGLOCK are fetched from ESPN’s public feeds. The page itself only displays that public sports data.

Your watchlists and settings are stored only in your own browser’s local storage on your device. LEGLOCK has no accounts and no sign-up, and there is no LEGLOCK server that receives or stores your personal information.

Cookies & advertising

Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on a user's prior visits to this website or other websites.

Google’s use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads to users based on their visits to this site and other sites on the Internet.

You may opt out of personalized advertising by visiting Google Ads Settings. You can also opt out of some third-party vendors’ use of cookies for personalized advertising at www.aboutads.info.

Other third parties

Player images load from ESPN’s CDN, and the advertising script loads from Google. When your browser requests those files, those services may log the request (such as your IP address and browser type) under their own privacy policies.

Changes & contact

If this policy changes, the updated version will be posted on this page with a new effective date. Questions about this policy can be sent via the section.

What LEGLOCK does

LEGLOCK is a prop research tool for the NBA, NFL, NHL and MLB. It tracks the top players in each league and shows how often their props have hit over the last 5, 10 and 20 games, calculated from real game logs (data: ESPN). It also includes team props and live scores.

What it isn’t

The prop lines shown are research lines calculated from players’ recent averages — they are not sportsbook odds. LEGLOCK does not accept bets and is not affiliated with any sportsbook, league, or ESPN. It is a research and entertainment tool, and nothing in it is betting advice.
